title: Lead Engineer Vertical Transportation (m/w/d)
description:

 Vielleicht ist diese Position bei Buro Happold genau das, was Du suchst!
 Aufgaben
 Umsetzung der planerischen Aufgaben für zugewiesene Projekte im definierten Planungsumfang sowie Verantwortlichkeiten als Projektleiter der Disziplin Fördertechnik/Vertical Transportation für alle Leistungsphasen einer Gebäudeplanung (z.B. HOAI, RIBA, AIA)
 Anwendung planungstechnischer tools wie Elevate, AutoCAD und Lift Designer
 Erarbeitung von technischen Spezifikationen für nicht-standardisierte Anlagen sowie Planung von Sonderanlagen
 Projektkommunikation und -dokumentation auf Deutsch und Englisch
 Technische Schnittstelle zu anderen Gewerken, Architekturbüros, Projektentwicklerinnen/ -entwicklern und herstellenden Unternehmen
 Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von internen Standards und Tools zur Optimierung des Planungsprozesses
 Qualitätsprüfung und -sicherung der Arbeit des gesamten Teams
 Unterstützung der Tätigkeiten des Vorgesetzten wie z.B. Projektplanung, Angebotserstellung, Ressourcenplanung etc.
 Aktivitäten zur Erweiterung des Serviceangebots und Kunden- , sowie Projektakquise
 Qualifikation
 Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Bauwesen oder gleichwertige Ausbildung) oder Techniker
 mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Aufzugsindustrie oder Fachplanung Fördertechnik sowie vorzugsweise Erfahrung in der fachlichen Leitung
 Gute Anwenderkenntnisse mit Elevate, AutoCAD und Lift Designer
 Ausreichende Kenntnisse zu Planungsphasen, Aufzugsvorschriften und lokalen Bauvorschriften in Europa und Middle-East
 sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Reisebereitschaft und hohe Motivation an internationaler Projektarbeit

title: Principal Engineer - Facades / External Walls
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. 

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

title: New Business Director
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination  (f/m/d)
description:
Clariness is looking for a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination - based remotely within Germany.
 - Part-time; limited -
 About the role:
 As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination, you will support our Online Marketing team in delivering engaging digital marketing initiatives that connect patients with clinical research opportunities. Working alongside experienced marketing professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience in content creation, digital campaigns, SEO and performance analysis while contributing to meaningful healthcare projects. Because you'll be creating and supporting content for our German-speaking audience, native-level German and fluent English are essential for success in this role.
 As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination , you would be responsible for:
 Support the planning, coordination and execution of digital marketing campaigns across multiple online channels.
 Assist in creating and optimising digital content, including website content, newsletters, landing pages and social media materials.
 Contribute to SEO initiatives through keyword research, on-page optimisation and website performance monitoring.
 Monitor campaign performance, compile reports and provide insights to support continuous optimisation.
 Conduct market, competitor and audience research to help identify opportunities for improving patient recruitment campaigns.
 Collaborate with colleagues across Online Marketing and other internal teams to support shared business objectives.
 Provide operational and administrative support to the Online Marketing team and assist with additional marketing projects as required.
 We would like you to have:
 Fluent German language skills (C2) and fluent English (C1/C2).
 Enrolled at a German university, ideally studying Marketing, Communication Science, Digital Media, or a related field.
